renamed_or_dropped_column.note: columns in the extract that do not match the documented schema

column_type_change.note: latitude/longitude are JSON strings, not numbers

date_format_switch.note: all rows share one ISO format in this extract; a mid-batch switch is what the injector models

latlon_swapped.note: no swapped pairs in this extract

missing_coordinates.note: a separate, larger problem than a swap

exact_duplicates.example: no two rows identical on every field
exact_duplicates.note: unique_key is unique; content duplicates do exist but are near-, not exact

near_duplicates.example: e.g. 32460 shares type/address/timestamp with another row
near_duplicates.note: same complaint, same address, same timestamp, different unique_key

null_spike.note: nulls are diffuse here, not concentrated in one agency's feed; Socrata omits the key entirely

zip_borough_mismatch.note: ZIP prefix contradicts the stated borough

complaint_descriptor_mismatch.note: descriptor drawn from a different complaint family

resolution_status_contradiction.example: The complaint you filed is a duplicate of a condition already reported by another tenant for a building-wide c

pii_in_text.example: The NYC Health Department has responded to your service request. For inspection results, please call (212) 676-1600 or e

missing_status.note: an unrecognised status value is itself a schema problem
